behavior_rules.rule: A swarm may be roused if its nest is invaded or if it is presented with strange smells or bright lights.

procedure.name: ward_off_swarm

steps.step: A character may ward off the swarm with a torch, weapon, or similar object.

procedure.outcome: Warding off a swarm with a torch or weapon inflicts 1d4 damage to the swarm.

procedure.name: flee_from_swarm

steps.step: If a character flees, resolve the lingering creatures.

procedure.outcome: It takes 3 rounds to swat off remaining creatures, during which the character may continue to suffer the swarm's effects.
procedure.follow_up: If the character flees into a body of water, the creatures are removed in 1 round. A swarm that has suffered damage will chase a fleeing character. If the fleeing character leaves the swarm's line of sight, the swarm cannot pursue.
